subject: Spot reassignment review + freeze exception request
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Spot reassignment review + freeze exception request

Hi Markus / Laura —

Following up on our 1:1 today: Alejandro (P6, infra) is leaving at the end of Q4. The infra team is already capacity-constrained through the product roadmap, and the current headcount freeze blocks a straightforward backfill. I want to propose a temporary spot reassignment + freeze-exception for one P6 replacement for 9 months to guarantee runbook handoffs and Q1 feature launches.

Key context:
- Impact: scheduler stability work + two infra feature launches (January, March) — missing coverage risks ~2–3 hour weekly incident workload increases for oncall team.
- Performance calibration: Alejandro received a strong review (5/5) and his direct workstream has two critical items tied to Dedicated latency savings.
- Cost: we estimate ~$160k fully loaded for the 9-month role; potential savings if we backfill internally are small given ramp time.

I attached an org sketch and a short perf-summary for Alejandro's work. Can you confirm whether a leadership-level exception (9 months) is approvable, and if so, what signoffs we need? If not, I need to prepare a phased coverage plan and identify contractors via TalentOps.

Thanks,
Kimberly
Kimberly Park
VP, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachments: org-chart-v3.pdf (diagram), perf-summaries_P6-team.xlsx (summary)
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T11:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Spot reassignment review + freeze exception request

Kim —

Thanks for the write-up and the attachments. Short replies:
1) I support a time-limited exception for a direct backfill for Alejandro given the risk to Dedicated latency work. This is material to revenue & SLAs.
2) We should propose a 6–9 month term; 6 months may be tight for ramp, so leaning 9 months.
3) Required approvals: Finance (cost carve-out), People Ops signoff (headcount exception form), and one exec sponsor (I'll champion).

Can you draft the freeze-exception form and a one-pager that calls out expected deliverables by month (handoff, feature launch, post-ramp oncall coverage)? I'll loop in finance and people.

Markus
Markus Klein
SVP, Product Engineering

Markus —

Attached is the completed freeze-exception-form.pdf and a draft one-pager with month-by-month milestones, estimated ramp curves, and a contingency plan (internal reassignment + contractor overlap). Highlights:
- Month 0–1: overlap + runbook transfer, critical incidents triage shadowing.
- Month 2–4: independent ownership of two infra features; begin performance checkpoints.
- Month 5–9: feature stabilization + SLA refinement; knowledge transfer to team for role sunsetting if we revert.

I also included a cost-sensitivity table (best/worst case) and two preferred candidates (internal transfer recommended for faster ramp).

TalentOps, can you provide availability and T&Cs for a 9-month contractor option if the exception is denied?

Thanks,
Kimberly

Date: 2026-12-08T14:37:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Spot reassignment review + freeze exception request

Kim / Markus —

Quick update after the exec sync this morning: Execs greenlight a 9-month spot exception with the following conditions:
- Finance needs monthly cost reporting against a dedicated chargeback (Cost center 3-IR).
- People Ops to approve the form and confirm no headcount carry on the org table after month 9 (sunset plan must be explicit).
- Candidate preference: internal transfer (faster ramp). If internal transfer not available within 3 weeks, People Ops will authorize a contractor bridge for up to 3 months while we finish a search.

Cora (Acme) — I'm looping you because Alejandro was a principal contact on the Dedicated integration work. We'll coordinate a handoff plan and a short joint runbook review session in early January; can you send any outstanding action items you need to keep live?

I'll collect the form signatures and the finance carve-out by Tuesday EOD.

Laura Bennett
Chief Customer Officer
Redwood Inference
